zh-CN.title: 广场自动加载与虚拟列表修复
items: 滚动接近广场底部时会自动加载更多发言，不再需要手动点击
离开可见区域的发言元素会被及时卸载，长时间浏览也能保持流畅

en.title: Fixed Square auto-loading and virtualization
items: More posts now load automatically as you approach the end of the Square feed
Off-screen post elements are now removed correctly to keep long browsing sessions smooth
